about: What the Roles page offers, by kind of business: written from web/lib/perms.ts (permGroups). web/lib/perms.test.mjs holds this file against that function, and the tablet's test holds its own list against this file, so the three cannot drift.

restaurant.title: Selling
perms: Give a discount that needs a manager
Delete an item before it is sent to the kitchen
Void an item after it was sent
Correct the payment type on a paid bill

restaurant.title: Orders and tables
perms: Change the waiter on an order
Transfer an order to another table
Mark an item sold out or back on sale on the till

restaurant.title: Cash
perms: Open the cash drawer without a sale
Put cash in and take cash out
Open the day and close it, count the drawer
See the day's figures on the till

restaurant.title: Receipts
perms: Reprint receipts, bills and kitchen orders

restaurant.title: Back office
perms: Sign in to the back office
Edit the menu, taxes and stock
Change settings, printers and tables; change how a till is set up and sign it out

retail.title: Selling
perms: Give a discount, on a sale or on one line

Take a line off a sale
Void an item after it was sent
Correct the payment type on a paid bill

retail.title: Orders and tables

retail.title: Cash
